summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd, a Cayman Islands company, reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on May 28-29, 2026. Shareholders approved a share consolidation (16:1), an increase in authorized share capital from $50,000 to $80 million (creating 45 billion Class A and 5 billion Class B shares), and adoption of amended articles. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation event such as acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. It reflects an issuer's ordinary capital-structure maintenance.
